text:
lee_sre: FYI apiserver 502/504s in us-east1 started ~10m ago, coincides with a big GPU attach wave. Not full outage but elevated errors and watch backlog.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] apiserver 5xx surge detected (us-east1) — error rate x8 over baseline.

lee_sre: quick log snippets: 
```
E1110 08:20:13.412 apiserver.go:318] http: proxy error: dial tcp 10.2.3.4:6443: connect: connection refused
E1110 08:20:13.689 apiserver.go:329] watch queue length: 4321
```

mina: digging into NAT metrics — ephemeral port exhaustion on the regional NATs. hit ~98% ephemeral usage during the attach spike.

oscar: kube-proxy conntrack entries also spiked. looks like parallel NodePort connections from onboarding nodes plus kubelet heartbeats blowing through the NAT.

tammy: etcd commit latencies rose around the same time, follower i/o retransmits visible. leader stayed stable but commit latency jumped from ~15ms -> ~200ms for 45s.

lee_sre: so root cause chain looks like: massive attach -> conntrack + NAT port exhaustion -> apiserver connection resets -> escalated watch backlog -> etcd commit spikes from retransmits.

mina: short-term fixes I can do now: 1) increase NAT port pool (spin another NAT gateway or enable port-preserving), 2) rate-limit the autoscaler attach concurrency.

oscar: i'll patch kube-proxy config to reduce conntrack_max and enable conntrack_tcp_timeout_established tuning for onboarding nodes.

tammy: i've opened a short-lived control-plane priority route to steer apiserver traffic through a dedicated NAT for the next 30m while we validate.

lee_sre: thanks. tammy — add the route and post when done.

billing-bot: [INFO] Estimated incremental cost for a temporary extra NAT gateway (us-east1) = $230/day.

members: :eyes:

mina: for the longer term we should: 1) stagger attaches in the autoscaler (max_parallel_attach), 2) reserve a small pool of non-preemptible GPUs for control-plane-critical workloads, 3) move control-plane egress off the public customer NAT.

lee_sre: agree. also add synthetic watch pressure tests to the canary pipeline so we catch these regressions before mass rollouts.

oscar: small config change pushed to autoscaler canary to set max_parallel_attach=5 and attach_backoff=30s. deploy-bot will schedule canary.

deploy-bot: helm upgrade scheduled: gpu-autoscaler v3.2.0-canary at 03:00 UTC (staggered attach enabled).

lee_sre: action items summary: mina add NAT capacity & monitor, oscar canary autoscaler config, tammy route control-plane egress to dedicated NAT, billing to model cost vs reliability for reserving 10% dedicated GPUs.

billing-bot: [ACTION] Creating cost model ticket CM-4122 for dedicated vs preemptible split (assign to tammy).

lee_sre: i'll add alerts: etcd commit latency > 100ms for 1m, apiserver watch backlog > 2000 for 2m, NAT ephemeral usage > 90% for 1m.

mina: INFRA ticket INFRA-8021 created for NAT capacity + conntrack tweaks. attaching current conntrack dump. :spiral_note_pad:

tammy: routed, monitoring shows reduced apiserver resets after route change (watch backlog dropping). will keep an eye for 30m.

lee_sre: excellent. we'll reconvene after the canary and the cost model. thanks everyone.
